The reader is given only "material": number, pulse, kind and words of each event.

A run ordered on day 1 loads on day 1 (7.2 hours at the source = 1 day), sails on day 2, and is due at base:2 on day 2. Without it the reading of day 3 is 80 t against 30 days x 10 t = 300 t: below the floor, so a run is needed. The stock projected for the reading of day 2 is 90 t. Load = max(0, 300 - 90) + 150 (15 days of use) = 360 t. Ships ship:1: 1 x the pool's free ships in number order = a room that covers the load. Passage 200 nm out at 10 kn = 20 hours, 1 day; 200 nm back = 20 hours, 1 day; unloading 360 t at base:2 = 18 hours, 1 day. Back at the source at hour 68 of the run and fuelled by hour 68.2 (0.2 hours at 200 t an hour), its ships are free on day 5, the morning after the day the fuelling ends. The staff adds this run to the plan.
